svg.title: Spacetime and spectral projection recovery. For the completed word section VW , define UZ(g) = VW U(g)V −1 W . On each word class this is exactly the lifted letterwise motion, so its group law, vacuum and invariant domain recover those of the source. Strong continuity is preserved quantitatively by ∥UZ(g)VW v −UZ(g0)VW v∥= ∥U(g)v −U(g0)v∥.
